named_probes: Probe 1: instrument the sequence and swap the staged bytes after validation returns, then record whether the installer installs the swapped content.
Probe 2 (mechanically different): static read of the installer to determine whether it re-checks the digest it was handed, or trusts a boolean result from the validator.
negative_control: control: without the swap, installation must succeed and the digest must match, so a failure caused by the instrumentation itself is distinguishable
note: Thin pointer (no unit_id/artifacts). Catalog receipt is output_path. SUCCESS set after live named probes exited 0. Per-unit manifest only.
